card.title: Stadium Lift
card.instruments: one clean electric guitar, sparse drums, bass
card.lyrics:
[verse]
Forty thousand hands up in the dark
Every one of them a spark
[chorus]
Lift lift lift
We are louder than the rain
Lift lift lift
Say it back to me again
card.note: Density experiment: same lyrics, key, tempo and seed as stadium_lift, with a thinner band. Testing whether arrangement density is what buries the vocal.
